purpose: Research decision experiment: can a scientifically defensible production Analysis transform be selected for high-resolution-mobile-esc?
architecture58: PRESERVED; this slice does not reopen Architecture 58

stormMotionPolicy.note: Fixed research comparison C, published Goshen Fig. 2b motion. NOT observed storm motion for Prospect or Dumas. Used only so operator-to-operator SRH is comparable. 88/167 are external, not a tuning target.

sourcePreservation: Source goldens unread-mutated. Output Analysis is research-only.
nativeDependency: C3 and C1-uniform1s require local gitignored native ESC files to reconstruct I1-retained TIME. Committed goldens alone are sufficient for C0, C1-native-index, C2, and the 100 m baseline.

gaps.note: Research interpolation onto integer seconds is not observational resolution.
